_readme: The weekly fight-night board: which stadium fights on which nights, from what time, for how much — read by muaythai_layer.py for /muaythai.html, the band on each stadium's page and the weekly events it feeds into /events.html and events.ics. Curated, never crawled. Every venue row names WHO stated the nights (`stated_by`) and where (`source`, `fetched`). `days` holds only what the venue itself states; what a listing or a reseller says goes in `days_reported`, by name and date, and renders as reported, never as the schedule. A venue with no stated days still appears — under 'ask before you go' — because silence about the weekday is not the same as no fights. Prices follow the same rule as everywhere on this site: `_pricesVerified` stays false until somebody reads the board at the door, and a card or page says so. Day codes are ICS BYDAY (MO TU WE TH FR SA SU). `venue_name` is the catalogue's canonical `name` for the place, so the event pins to the record exactly.
